summary: Latent-space reasoning (Native Thinking) + reinforcement learning for Xingcheng. Continuous-thought steps are performed inside hidden state space (no detokenized CoT); parallel hypothesis branches are decoded from private KV slots and self-verified by model confidence (latent CoVe); GRPO trains the policy on verifiable rewards.

flow: prefill: prompt KV on slot 0, last hidden row seeds first thought
think_steps: feed previous hidden row back as input embedding via BatchSpan::embed_override; occupies one KV position each; never detokenizes
fork: kv_copy_slot clones slot-0 KV into K private branch slots
decode: each branch samples independently from the final-thought logits
verify: branch scored by mean token logprob (model self-confidence); argmax supplies the final answer
cleanup: every branch slot is freed (also on throw)

max_new_tokens.note: clamped by serve; prompt+think_steps+max_new must fit max_position_embeddings

kv_isolation.guarantee: branch slots hold private copies of prompt+thought KV; no shared mutable KV across hypotheses

embedding_override.semantics: when set, replaces the token embedding with the supplied hidden_size vector (validated); works in legacy and gemma4 embed paths; PLE per-layer input is neutralized for latent positions

training.summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization: on-policy group rollouts, verifiable reward, group-normalized advantage, policy gradient with KL-to-reference regularization.
training.data_format: grpo jsonl: {"prompt_ids": [...], "completion_ids": [...]} — completion is the verifiable target
flow: sample G=group_size rollouts per prompt at rollout temperature
reward each rollout: exact match (1.0/0.0) or matched-prefix fraction
loss per rollout = (-adv * lp_policy + kl_coef * (lp_policy - lp_ref)) / completion_len
backprop soft-grad (softmax - onehot) over completion positions only

fail_closed: unsupported bounds throw InferenceError, never silently clamp or fall back to textual CoT
no python runtime in the thinking or GRPO path
